prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production background illustration for the Laoshu Laoshi PLAYGROUND minigame hub, landscape 3:2, opaque. This is a revision of the concept: a calm spacious outdoor playground ONLY, with the athletics circuit entirely inside the separate gym, not in this picture. No track, hurdles or obstacle circuit outdoors.
Raised three-quarter view, a coherent small Chinese village courtyard play park. Four large easily distinguishable activity objects with plenty of open grass and sandy paths between: a simple two-seat timber swing set at left middle; paired red and indigo curved speaking tubes at center middle; a low circular inset trampoline at right foreground; a short group of broad colorful stepping stones at left foreground. At rear right a modest cream-plaster gym with indigo tiled roof and inviting open door, large enough to be a clear clickable destination. At rear left a wide open moon gate in the low garden wall reveals the path back to the village town. Both exits must be conspicuous and visually separate. Keep the center comfortably open. Minimal low planting and only one framing tree. No distant elaborate landscape, no excessive flowers, no rocks filling the foreground, no characters. Clear whole silhouettes, generous gaps, easy clickable regions. Cozy and playful, like a classic virtual-pet minigame hub in an original Chinese storybook world. Architecture and equipment should be charming, practical and believable.
Flat gouache and folk woodblock shapes on handmade paper; warm cream, indigo, muted jade, terracotta and restrained ochre; imperfect painted edges, paper grain, shallow layer shadows, soft daylight. Softly painted simplified forms rather than dense realistic detail. No photorealism, glossy 3D or vector look. No writing, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or interface. No radio. All signs blank; the app supplies accessible labels and game states. Keep the complete scene visible without cropped equipment.

validation_findings: Inspected: four separated activity areas, open grass, gym doorway and town moon gate visible.
No text or characters; no outdoor circuit; equipment whole.
3:2 opaque scene; mobile hotspot validation pending.

prompt:
Create the companion GYM INTERIOR to the provided playground illustration. Use the playground as a continuity and painted-style reference. This is a new interior viewpoint in the same building, not a copy of the outdoor layout. One full-frame 3:2 opaque illustration for a clickable minigame hub.
A cozy spacious Chinese village gym with cream plaster walls, timber beams, warm wooden floor and muted indigo trim. Raised interior three-quarter view, enough floor visible to read a small literal athletics circuit. A simple oval painted floor line occupies the broad central/foreground floor, with four low miniature hurdles on one stretch, three upright hoops on another, broad stepping pads on another, and a low balance beam on the last. Clear large simple equipment, generous spacing, no visual clutter. These support a tone-pair circuit; do NOT put numbers, letters or tone marks in the image. App overlays will supply exact sixteen stations.
On the rear wall a LARGE broad window looks onto the matching outdoor playground: recognizable two-seat timber swings, grass, and red/indigo speaking tubes seen from this reverse direction. To the left of that window is an open door leading directly back onto the playground. On the right wall a second clearly separate open doorway leads to a quiet village lane with a cream wall and indigo roof glimpse, the direct way back to town. Both doorways fully visible and large enough to click. Two quiet additional activity corners: a single rolled mat with an unrolled indigo mat at rear left, a pair of hanging exercise rings near rear right. Keep doors, window, and activity equipment unoccluded.
Match the reference palette and medium: gouache and folk woodblock shapes on handmade paper, warm cream, indigo, muted jade, terracotta and restrained ochre, imperfect painted edges, paper grain, soft daylight and shallow shadows. Simplify decorative detail; calm inviting open room, not crowded. No characters, no radio, no text, labels, signs with writing, UI, watermarks, trophies, shelves of trinkets, or unrelated objects. Preserve the recognizable outdoor equipment through the window. No photorealism, glossy 3D or clean vector look.

input_references.role: companion scene continuity and style reference

validation_findings: Inspected: gym interior with obstacle oval, playground door left and distinct town door right.
Playground swings and speaking tubes recognizable through large window; style consistent.
Three rather than four miniature hurdles; accepted as decorative hub, exact sixteen drill stations supplied by app.
No visible writing/characters; mobile hotspot validation pending.
